forum.title: Unable to build project
forum.best_answer_content:
The problem was eventually resolved after rebuilding the project several times.

Although the cause remains unknown, development can now proceed.
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I created a project (BLE\_p2pServer) in STM32CubeMX (6.18.0), but it won't build.

Unlike other projects, this project has a folder-like icon in the Project Explorer.

I created the project using the same procedure as other projects (BLE\_TransparentMode, etc.), so do you know why this is happening?

Deleting and recreating the project doesn't change the situation.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/9f421056-2ee1-475a-b28b-172577d7bf48.png)
